Two silhouetted figures — a dancer and a large man — flank bold white Cyrillic text 'АНГЛИЙСКИЙ ЯЗЫК'. Stylized, dramatic promotional aesthetic.

nodes.subject: Russian Language

nodes.label: Kubik Icon (Open Book)
nodes.description: Standalone Kubik brand icon — an open book or cube/box outline rendered as a minimalist line drawing in dark navy/steel blue. The shape resembles an open book viewed from the front or an isometric cube top face. Clean geometric style on white background.
nodes.visual_style: navy blue line icon, white background, geometric open-book/cube shape

nodes.label: Kubik Logo (Dark / Text Only)
nodes.description: Kubik brand wordmark — 'KUBIK' in bold black sans-serif uppercase letters with thin horizontal decorative lines flanking the text on left and right. White/very light background. Text-only variant without the book icon.
nodes.visual_style: black text on white, geometric sans-serif, flanking horizontal rules

nodes.label: Kubik Logo (Transparent Background)
nodes.description: Full Kubik brand logo with transparent/off-white background — navy blue open-book/cube icon above the 'KUBIK' wordmark with flanking horizontal rules. Stacked vertical layout. Suitable for placement on colored backgrounds.
nodes.visual_style: navy icon + black wordmark, transparent/off-white background, stacked layout

nodes.label: Kubik Logo (Standard / White Background)
nodes.description: Full Kubik brand logo on white background — navy blue open-book/cube icon above the 'KUBIK' wordmark with flanking horizontal rules. Stacked vertical layout. Primary brand logo variant.
nodes.visual_style: navy icon + black wordmark, white background, stacked layout

nodes.label: Mathematics Subject Banner
nodes.description: Cinematic subject banner for Mathematics (Математика). Dark blue background with a chalkboard full of mathematical formulas/equations. Two figures — a man looking up and a woman writing on a board. Bold white Cyrillic text 'МАТЕМАТИКА'. Dramatic, stylized aesthetic.
nodes.visual_style: dark blue, cinematic, bold white Cyrillic text, chalkboard formulas, silhouette figures
nodes.subject: Mathematics

nodes.label: Physics Subject Banner
nodes.description: Cinematic subject banner for Physics (Физика). Dark blue chalkboard background with physics equations (E=mc², wave functions, etc.) and geometric diagrams. Retro-styled human figures (scientists/students). Bold white Cyrillic text 'ФИЗИКА'. Dramatic, vintage scientific aesthetic.
nodes.visual_style: dark blue chalkboard, cinematic, bold white Cyrillic text, physics equations, vintage figures
nodes.subject: Physics

nodes.label: Russian Language Subject Banner
nodes.description: Cinematic subject banner for Russian Language (Русский язык). Dark navy background with handwritten Russian text/cursive. Two silhouetted figures — a stylish woman and a person with a megaphone. Bold white Cyrillic text 'РУССКИЙ ЯЗЫК'. Dramatic, stylized aesthetic.
nodes.visual_style: dark navy, cinematic, bold white Cyrillic text, handwritten Russian text, silhouette figures
nodes.subject: Russian Language

nodes.description: React framework logo as SVG source file — the classic cyan (#61DAFB) atomic orbital symbol. Default Create React App source SVG, used as the basis for the PNG logo assets. Not the Kubik brand logo.
